subject: Namami Gange Mission Phase II — the national river programme the Yamuna work sits inside
transcription: Read off the source release, once, and COMMITTED. Every figure below is quoted from it. The derived block states its own arithmetic.

source.name: Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India
source.why_this_document: The Yamuna is a Ganga tributary and Delhi's sewerage work is funded through this mission. Without the national figure, the Delhi figure has no scale. Same discipline as the Yamuna reply: quote the number, attach the document, infer nothing beyond the arithmetic.

sewerage.quote: A total of 218 number of sewerage infrastructure projects (STPs) costing 35,698 crores have been taken up for remediation of polluted river areas with treatment capacity of 6,610 Million Liters per Day (MLD). 138 STPs with a capacity of 3,977 MLD have been completed and made operational.

other_work.dolphin_source: the first country-wide assessment of river dolphins, Wildlife Institute of India with State Forest Departments

biomonitoring_locations.finding: biological water quality predominantly ranged from 'Good' to 'Moderate'

derived.note: Arithmetic on the figures above, each stating its own operation.

capacity_completed_pct.reading: Three fifths of the treatment capacity paid for under the mission is running. Two fifths is not yet.

projects_completed_pct.reading: Roughly two thirds of the sanctioned projects are finished.

share_of_2025_additions.sum: 530 MLD commissioned in 2025 as a share of 3977 MLD operational
share_of_2025_additions.reading: An eighth of everything now running was switched on during 2025.

what_cannot_be_computed.national_cost_per_mld: The release gives the cost of all 218 SANCTIONED projects and the capacity of the 138 COMPLETED ones. Those two figures do not divide into a meaningful cost per MLD, because the numerator and denominator describe different sets. Delhi's cost per MLD is computable only because its Yamuna reply gives cost and capacity for the same nine completed projects. The national figure is therefore not published here, and this note exists so nobody computes it later by mistake.
what_cannot_be_computed.total_ever_spent_on_the_ganga: Not in this release. As with the Yamuna, the widely circulated lifetime totals trace to journalism reporting parliamentary panels, not to the panels' own documents.

caveats: This covers the Ganga basin mission, of which the Yamuna is one tributary. It is not a Yamuna figure.
A parliamentary release is the government describing its own programme. It is authoritative as a record of what was stated and is not independently audited.
'Completed and made operational' is a statement about a plant existing and running. It is not a statement about its discharge meeting a standard — the Delhi reply shows those are different things.
Sanctioned cost is not spent cost, and the release does not give the spent figure.
